sections.heading: Kanimozhi Karunanidhi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Kanimozhi Karunanidhi was born on 5 January 1968 in Chennai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Muthuvel Karunanidhi and her mother, Rajathi Ammal. She is a sibling of M. K. Stalin and M. K. Alagiri.
Her listed education includes Ethiraj College for Women.
She is recorded as speaking Tamil and English.
